title: 年轻市场参与者为何热衷高风险？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: There are many types of risk, and now even trading is an extreme sport.
segments.zh: 风险类型很多，如今连交易都成了极限运动。

segments.en: In this video, I will start with risking only $100 per trade.
segments.zh: 本视频中，我先从每笔交易只冒100美元风险开始。

segments.en: Bro, it's simple. If you can scope TikTok, you can trade.
segments.zh: 兄弟，很简单。你能刷抖音，就能交易。

segments.en: You have the fear of missing out on a trade. And judging by social media, everyone is getting rich.
segments.zh: 你害怕错过交易。从社交媒体看，似乎人人都在发财。

segments.en: We're at $232,000. Just today, I made $16,000.
segments.zh: 现在有23.2万美元。光今天就赚了1.6万。

segments.en: More young people are investing than ever before, and they're learning about markets in a way no generation has.
segments.zh: 更多年轻人投身市场，他们学习市场的方式前所未有。

segments.en: Gen Z really is distinct from other age groups. If you go on social media now, you will see a lot of sophisticated trading techniques
segments.zh: Z世代确实与众不同。现在社交媒体上能看到很多复杂的交易技巧。

segments.en: used in ways that I think no one would have imagined a 20-year-old in 1990, 2000, or even 2010 doing or even knowing about.
segments.zh: 这些技巧的运用方式，是1990、2000甚至2010年的20岁年轻人无法想象或了解的。

segments.en: I want to show you this trade I'm taking. A lot of that activity has also broadened to sports gambling, for instance, or trading on prediction markets.
segments.zh: 我想展示这笔交易。很多活动也扩展到了体育博彩或预测市场交易。

segments.en: But there are worries that these investors are overleveraged, taking one too many risks.
segments.zh: 但有人担心这些市场参与者杠杆过高，冒了太多风险。

segments.en: I've always been a big risk taker. It's kind of just part of who I am.
segments.zh: 我一直是个高风险偏好者，这几乎就是我的一部分。

segments.en: Three, two, one, to the f**k mode!
Holy s**t! Well, you know what?
Gen Z has a highly differentiated view of risk.
segments.zh: Z世代对风险有着高度差异化的看法。

segments.en: They don't drive, they don't date, they don't drink.
segments.zh: 他们不驾车、不约会、不喝酒。
